null_recovery_round8_2026_07_03.worklist_outcome: No FILLS and no CORRECTIONS. All three target nulls confirmed genuinely absent (hardened). The report discloses only a premium-to-independent-valuation for both deals and never prints the valuation figure itself; deriving it (e.g. 161.7/1.03 or 99.7/1.137) is prohibited by the no-derive invariant.

hardened_absent.reason: No independent valuation figure is printed for the deal. Capital Recycling (p34) states the sale 'was executed at a 3% premium to their independent valuations' — a premium is disclosed, the valuation amount is not, and deriving it is prohibited. The Valuation of Properties table (p28) shows CyberVale and CyberPearl FY2025 valuation as '-' (footnote 3: 'Divested on 29 September 2025'). Note 25a (p146) prints only carrying amounts (IP 138,890), net assets of disposal group (155,841), gain (4,081) and net sales consideration (159,922) — no appraised valuation.

hardened_absent.key: 20.2% stake in three data centre developments (DC Chennai, DC ITPH, DC Navi Mumbai) (divestment)
hardened_absent.reason: No independent valuation figure printed. Note 25b (p147): 'The investment properties and investment properties under construction are valued based on the agreed property value with the buyer' (an agreed-with-buyer value, not an independent appraisal). Capital Recycling (p34): 'The partial divestment was executed at a 13.7% premium to their independent valuation' — premium disclosed, valuation amount not; deriving prohibited. The p28 table gives 100% property valuations in INR million (DC Chennai 7,464; DC ITPH 12,310; DC Navi Mumbai 32,198) but those are FY2025 year-end 100% valuations, not the 20.2%-stake deal valuation, and summing/pro-rating would be a prohibited derivation.

hardened_absent.key: 20.2% stake in three data centre developments (DC Chennai, DC ITPH, DC Navi Mumbai) (divestment)
hardened_absent.reason: No carrying value for the 20.2% divested stake is printed. Note 25b (p147) prints only the FULL (100%) disposal-group at fair value: Investment properties under construction 649,592 + Investment properties 88,930 = 738,522; net assets of disposal group 463,350. The deal is a 20.2% stake (consideration S$99.7m) completed 27 Feb 2026 (next FY) — no gain, and thus no carrying-value basis, is recognised in FY2025. Pro-rating 20.2% x the 100% figure is a prohibited derivation, and recording the 100% figure against a 20.2% consideration would be a conflation. Per no-derive invariant: only the sale price is printed, so it is kept and carrying/valuation left null.
